input_patterns: sector rotation watchlist with breadth

sql_templates.description: Identify sectors with improving breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma::numeric) AS avg_pct_above_50dma
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY sector
), latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT b.sector, b.avg_pct_above_50dma, s.stage2_count
FROM latest_breadth b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.sector = s.sector
ORDER BY s.stage2_count DESC, b.avg_pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 5;

sql_templates.description: Get candidate symbols from the top sectors.
sql_templates.query:
SELECT ss.symbol, ss.company_name, ss.stage_score
FROM scores.stage_snapshots ss
JOIN (
    SELECT sector
    FROM (
        SELECT b.sector, s.stage2_count
        FROM (
            SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma::numeric) AS avg_pct_above_50dma
            FROM breadth.sector_daily
            WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
            GROUP BY sector
        ) b
        JOIN (
            SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count
            FROM scores.stage_snapshots
            WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
            AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
            GROUP BY sector
        ) s ON b.sector = s.sector
    ) subquery
    ORDER BY stage2_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
) top_sectors ON ss.sector = top_sectors.sector
WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Identify sectors with improving breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) as latest_date FROM breadth.sector_daily),
    sector_leaders AS (
    SELECT sd.sector, sd.breadth_signal, ma.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    WHERE sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_snapshots)
      AND sd.breadth_signal = 'Improving'
      AND ma.stage2_pct > 50
)
SELECT * FROM sector_leaders ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC LIMIT 10;

validation_rules: rules
